text:
Celebrities including Chow Yun-fat, Stephen Fung Tak-lun and William Chan Wai-ting slashed prices before selling luxury properties recently, with property agents saying secondary luxury home trading will continue to slow in the short term, with prices up to 10 per cent lower.

text_zh: 包括周润发、冯德伦和陈伟霆在内的名人近期在出售豪宅前纷纷降价，房地产中介表示，短期内二手豪宅交易将继续放缓，价格可能下降多达10%。香港影星周润发位于阳光别墅的独立屋叫价……
